items.title: Erdős Problem 1171 — mono k
items.excerpt: OrdinalMultiColorRamsey is monotone in the number of non-zero colors: a witness for the k-color version yields one for any j ≤ k.

items.title: Erdős Problem 23 — blowupC5 tight
items.excerpt: The blow-up of C_5 shows that the bound n^2 in Erdős Problem 23 is tight: any bipartite subgraph must omit at least n^2 edges.

items.title: Erdős Problem 23 — n1
items.excerpt: Every triangle-free graph on 5 vertices can be made bipartite by removing at most 1 edge. This is the n = 1 case of Erdős Problem 23.
